FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Bagel Bakehouse
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Bagel Way, Suite 100, New York, NY 10001-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Fresh Bagel Bakehouse, we specialize in creating fresh, delicious bagels and baked goods, prepared daily on our premises to ensure quality and authenticity. Our operations include not only the production of various bagels but also an assortment of pastries and light breakfast items made with high-quality, locally-sourced ingredients. We maintain rigorous food safety protocols, including ServSafe certification for our staff, and adhere to strict sanitation and refrigeration controls to prevent spoilage and ensure food quality. Our establishment is equipped with monitored fire and burglar alarm systems, significantly reducing safety risks. We proudly implement cybersecurity measures for our online ordering platform, securing customer information. With dedicated early morning hours and a focus on breakfast and lunch service, we strive to provide a warm, welcoming environment for both dine-in and takeout customers.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: "Bagel Delights LLC, a local catering service specializing in bagel platters and breakfast catering for events, operating out of the same facility."
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 01/15/2023, a kitchen fire caused by a malfunctioning toaster resulted in damage to equipment and inventory amounting to $2,000. The fire was quickly contained, and all safety protocols were followed. The claim is currently closed with no further action needed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class B Safe, Grade I, UL listed fire-rated.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored security camera system in addition to existing fire and burglar alarms, enhancing overall safety and security measures.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. We adhere to all safety and regulatory requirements, focusing on food safety and quality.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse does not sponsor athletic teams. Our focus is primarily on providing high-quality baked goods and maintaining food safety standards.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our management team to ensure compliance and proper risk transfer.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse has not been indicted or convicted of any crime related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related offense. The business maintains a strong commitment to ethical operations and compliance with the law.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. All insurance requirements have been met and maintained without issue.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse does not lease employees to or from other employers, ensuring full control and compliance with our staffing and operational practices.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse carries Workers Compensation insurance, ensuring compliance with state regulations and providing coverage for our employees. This policy is active and in place to protect our workforce.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse also operates "Bagel Delights LLC," a local catering service specializing in bagel platters and breakfast catering for events, which operates out of the same facility.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company beyond the ones listed. The business is focused on maintaining high safety and regulatory compliance standards.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products beyond the baking of our own bagels and pastries on-site. Our operations focus on retailing freshly baked goods prepared daily for our customers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse does not rent or loan equipment to others, as we focus solely on our own baking operations and maintain strict control over all equipment used on-site.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, indicating financial stability.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond what is typically found in food preparation. We maintain strict adherence to safety and regulatory standards to ensure a safe operating environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse does not have any catastrophe exposure that would pose a significant risk to operations. The establishment has implemented comprehensive safety measures and procedures to mitigate potential hazards.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain a strong commitment to ethical operations and compliance with all applicable laws.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh Bagel Bakehouse does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. All fire safety measures are up to date, including an automatic extinguishing system and monitored alarm systems.
